info.title: API.SH: OLX
info.description: The OLX API from API.SH: public OLX data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An OLX category page in Poland, Ukraine, Romania, Bulgaria, Portugal, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan or Brazil: the category (id, name, path, link, listing count, page title), its parent categories and subcategories with their listing counts, the city or region when the page has one, and its listings (40 per page plus promoted ones) with the same fields as /olx/v1/search, including `raw`. Give the category's path or page link, or its `category_id`; with none, the top-level categories are returned. Sort, price range, region/city and condition filters apply. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site serves at most 1,000 results per listing).

Brazil (`country=BR`): with no category, the whole category tree (ids, names, paths, subcategories); with a `path` such as `autos-e-pecas/carros-vans-e-utilitarios` (brand and model slugs may follow) or `category_id`, the category, its parent and subcategories and its listings (50 per page, up to page 100) with every /olx/v1/search filter for Brazil, including `available_filters`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/olx-category

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Category slugs as in the site's addresses, e.g. `elektronika/telefony` (a city slug may follow, e.g. `elektronika/telefony/warszawa`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A category page link instead of `path` and `country`, e.g. https://www.olx.pl/elektronika/telefony/.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Site country (default PL).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Numeric category id instead of `path` (category ids appear in results as `category_id`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default relevance).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Region id.

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description: City id.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Item condition, e.g. new, used, damaged.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1, max 25; Brazil max 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One OLX listing by link or id: title, full description, price (currency, label, negotiable, previous price), condition and every attribute, category, location (city, district, region, map position), dates, status, photos, delivery flag and the seller's public summary (id, name, member since, last seen, business page). India listings also carry favourites. Brazil listings (olx.com.br) carry the full description, attributes and feature summary, state, zip code and area code, online payment with Pix price and installments, delivery, the FIPE reference price and financing terms for vehicles, and the seller (name, id, professional flag, rating, sales count, dispatch time, profile link). The link's domain sets the country.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/olx-item

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An OLX listing link (olx.pl, olx.ua, olx.ro, olx.bg, olx.pt, olx.kz, olx.uz, olx.in or olx.com.br).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The listing's numeric id, instead of `url` (with `country`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country for `id`: PL (default), UA, RO, BG, PT, KZ, UZ, IN, BR.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Classified listings on OLX in Poland, Ukraine, Romania, Bulgaria, Portugal, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, India and Brazil, with the site's filters: sort, price range, category, region/city (India: location), condition, seller type, photos, delivery and category attributes. Category attribute filters (not India) are passed through as they appear in the site's search URLs, as extra query parameters, e.g. `filter_float_year:from=2018`, `filter_enum_petrol[0]=diesel` (up to 20; attribute keys are listed in each result's `attributes`). Each listing: id, title, link, description, price, currency and label, negotiable flag, condition and the other attributes, category, city, district, region, map position, creation/refresh/expiry dates, business flag, promotion and delivery flags, seller id and name, photos, and `raw` (the site's record). `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site serves at most 1,000 results per search outside India).

Brazil (`country=BR`, olx.com.br): keywords, `category` (the site's category path, e.g. `autos-e-pecas/carros-vans-e-utilitarios`, optionally followed by brand and model slugs such as `/toyota/corolla`) or `category_id`, `state` (UF) with `region` and `area` slugs, price range, sort, seller type and the category's own filters as `filter_<key>=<value>` (comma-separated for several values, e.g. `filter_rs=2018` for year from, `filter_gb=2` for automatic gearbox, `filter_ros=3` for 3+ bedrooms). Every Brazil response lists the filters its category accepts in `available_filters` (param names and allowed values). Brazil listings also carry state, area code, online payment, delivery and seller-rating fields; 50 per page, up to page 100.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/olx-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `iphone`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: PL (default), UA, RO, BG, PT, KZ, UZ, IN or BR.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price (local currency).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price (local currency).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: The site's category id (category_id in results), e.g. 99 for phones on olx.pl.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Region id (not India), e.g. 8.

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description: City id (not India).

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: India only: location id (city or area), e.g. 4058526 for Hyderabad.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Not India: new, used or damaged (where the category has a condition).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: owner_type
parameters.description: Not India: private or business sellers only.

parameters.name: has_photo
parameters.description: Not India: true for listings with photos only.

parameters.name: delivery
parameters.description: Not India: true for listings that offer delivery only.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Brazil only: the category path as in olx.com.br links, e.g. `celulares`, `imoveis/venda`, `autos-e-pecas/carros-vans-e-utilitarios/toyota/corolla` (see /olx/v1/category?country=BR). Brazil also takes `category_id` (e.g. 2020 for cars).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Brazil only: two-letter state (UF), e.g. SP, RJ, MG.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Brazil only, with state: the region slug from olx.com.br links, e.g. `sao-paulo-e-regiao`.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Brazil only, with region: the area slug, e.g. `zona-sul`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A seller's public OLX profile and their active listings: name, business flag and type, company name, description and website (business sellers), logo, member since, last seen, response time, profile link, listing count and the listings (as in search). India: the profile only (name, about, member since, verification badges). Brazil (`country=BR`): professional and private sellers, by the seller id from /olx/v1/item (`seller.id`) or an olx.com.br/perfil/ link: name, description, benefits, business vertical, logo, city and state (a professional seller's street address when it shows it publicly; private sellers by town only, phone numbers in their description hidden), verification, member since, last seen, the seller's categories and states, and their listings (50 per page) with `sort` (newest, price_asc, price_desc), `q` and `category_id` filters. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/olx-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The seller's numeric id (seller_id in search and item results); for Brazil the seller id (seller.id in item results) or an olx.com.br/perfil/ link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: PL (default), UA, RO, BG, PT, KZ, UZ, IN or BR.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Brazil only: newest (default), price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Brazil only: keywords within the seller's listings.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Brazil only: one of the seller's categories (`categories` in the response).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
